people.imagined: At the market's standard scale she stoops to read the balance, tall above everyone, a tiny tattooed beam-balance showing at her wrist. She has just found the cinnabar light again.
people.subject: The moment: a very tall woman stoops over a great bronze standard balance to read its beam, glancing sideways at the viewer with a level look. Face: long, calm and pale; level grey eyes; thin straight brows; a long straight nose; a quiet, firm mouth; high cheekbones; fine lines from nose to mouth corners and skin dry from the sun. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a smooth high knot held by a silver pin. Body: extremely tall, slim, stooping gently. Clothing: layered silk in deep bronze and earth-gold, two crossed collars showing at the neck, wide sleeves falling in long folds under an iron-grey over-robe; the collar borders embroidered in gold with the seven Dipper stars; a broad sash with a black cord of seven knots and a small silver star hung at the collar; her sleeves are pushed back a little as she works. Hands and objects (the tattoo must read): on the inside of her right wrist a small blue-black tattoo of a beam balance with two pans, plainly visible as her hand rests on the beam; beside her the great bronze balance with bright round weights in a row. Power: a faint steel-grey shimmer, fine as filed metal dust, drifts above the balance pans. Background: a dark market plaza in soft mist, paper lanterns and the shapes of stalls kept to the edges. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left with a pale rim along her cheek and sleeve. Expression: level, fair and even, the calm of a woman exact to the last grain who expects no thanks for it.

people.imagined: At the black-iron mine mouth, shoulders like a cart-yoke; he is patient, easy, leaning on a cart loaded with a single ingot. He could carry two for a bet and often does.
people.subject: The moment: at a mine mouth he stands with one hand resting on a cart bearing a single huge black ingot, looking calmly at the viewer with a slow, easy smile. Face: broad, heavy and dark, with fine black iron dust in the creases of brow and neck; calm small brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide flat nose; a slow wide mouth; grey stubble; a few old nicks across the brow. Hair: black-grey, cropped, dusted grey. Body: huge, shoulders wide as a cart yoke, a thick neck, long heavy arms. Clothing: stately layered silk in deep bronze and earth-gold, the crossed collars embroidered with mountain ridges, wide sleeves bound back at the forearms for work, an iron-grey over-robe, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and a heavy yellow jade pendant, a broad padded yoke-cloth of dark silk over the shoulders; the hem carries a little grey dust. Hands and objects: one large hand resting on a long black iron ingot lying on a small cart; a miner's pick held over his shoulder, its head gleaming. Power: slow motes of steel-grey light gather around the ingot and drift off his sleeve. Background: the dark mouth of a mine in drifting mist, old timbers and a string of small lanterns marking the path into the hill. Light: warm lantern glow from the lower left, cold silvery spirit-light from above, a soft rim on his shoulders. Expression: a slow, easy, contented smile with heavy-lidded eyes, the unbothered calm of an enormous man who could carry two ingots and will if you bet him.

people.imagined: On the guard wall in the cold, he says nothing for a very long time before he speaks. The left ear is notched. He is thinking about a boy with a frozen foot who must hold his post.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a wall parapet in the cold he turns heavy-browed eyes toward the viewer and says nothing, jaw set. Face (most important: heavy brows and notched ear): hard, square and weathered; very heavy, thick, shaggy black brows shadowing small dark eyes; the LEFT ear has a clear notch bitten from its edge; a broad nose; a thick closed mouth; short black stubble; deep lines from nose to mouth corners and frost white in the brows. Hair: black, cropped short, bristles even over the whole skull, a thin white scar behind the right ear. Body: broad and dense, a statue of a man. Clothing: stately silk in deep bronze and earth-gold under a black silk outer robe with a high collar, dark grey armour plates sewn over the breast with a fur collar, collar borders embroidered with the Dipper stars, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands folded on the pommel of a long straight sword planted in front of him; his breath steams in the cold. Power: faint steel-grey motes of cold light cling to the sword's edge. Background: a stone parapet and a snow slope in blue mist, a watch lantern glowing far behind. Light: pale blue-white moonlight from the upper left, a thin silver rim on his brow and armour. Expression: brave, loyal and callous, a long silence; his gaze level and unhurried, as of a man who will outwait anyone.

people.imagined: At dusk on the wall, he squints toward the shut gate across the valley, half lifts his hand in a wave, and lowers it. Nobody has waved back since 1189.
people.subject: The moment: on a wall at dusk he squints across a valley with one hand half-raised in a wave he is stopping in mid-air. Face (most important: the squint): a thin, boyish, tanned face; eyes squeezed into a sentry's squint with deep lines at their corners and white creased skin around them; thin brows; a long thin nose; a slightly open, hopeful mouth beginning to close; a wispy first moustache; chapped lips. Hair: black, short and a little spiky, a pale grey silk ribbon tied round the brow with a few wisps sticking up behind it. Body: thin, tall for his age, a bit hunched. Clothing: graceful silk in bronze and earth-gold with two crossed collars, a short iron-grey over-robe with slim sleeves, collar borders embroidered with small mountain ridges, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and no star. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted halfway in a hesitating wave, the left on a spear shaft; slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword a little too long for his frame, grip wrapped in grey hemp cord, a small round iron guard, a pale scrape on its grey-painted scabbard and a short knot of faded pale-blue thread at the pommel. Power: a few thin steel-grey motes rise from the sword hilt. Background: a twilight valley in rose-violet mist, a far shut fort with one small light. Light: soft orange-pink dusk glow from the upper left with a gentle rim on his cheek. Expression: brave, fickle and trusting; hoping, hope draining slowly out of his eyes as the hand drops.

people.imagined: Dusting the old stones of the bridge in the store room, a pinch of incense ash on her cheek. She keeps the ash to sell and is calm about it.
people.subject: The moment: in a storeroom she holds a soft cloth to a small grey stone on a shelf, looking round with neat composure and a smudge of ash on her cheek. Face: a smooth, prim, round face; calm brown eyes; neat thin brows; a small straight nose; a small tidy mouth; a pair of fine lines between the brows from years of careful counting. Hair: black with grey, in a prim tight bun with a jade pin. Body: small, neat, round-shouldered. Clothing: soft layered silk in deep bronze and earth-gold, perfectly clean, crossed collars buttoned neatly with a border of embroidered Dipper stars, narrow sleeves with a little grey ash on the cuffs, an iron-grey over-robe, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a cloth and a small weathered grey stone block in her hands; on a shelf behind her rows of identical round grey jars of ash and a bronze censer with a thin line of scented smoke. Power: faint ochre motes of earth light float up from the old stone and settle in the smoke. Background: a dim storeroom in soft haze, tall stacked sacks fading into shadow, one lantern throwing a pale gold circle. Light: warm lantern gold from the upper left with a silver rim from the censer smoke. Expression: a calm, neat, prim face with the smallest satisfied tuck at the mouth, the modest look of a woman who keeps the ash to sell and is entirely at ease about it.

people.imagined: On the harbour wall in a sea breeze, with a gold hoop in one ear, rolling on her feet as if the deck were moving. She is looking at the old harbour master's house and thinking about when he will die.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pier with a rolling sailor's stance, arms folded and chin lifted, a bright gold hoop glinting in one ear. Face: sharp, tanned and handsome; keen green eyes; strong arched brows; a straight nose; a bold, thin-lipped smile with impatience in it; fine salt-whitened lines beside her eyes and a thin pale scar on the chin. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a faded blue silk ribbon, loose strands whipped by the wind. Body: strong and lean, sea legs apart, hips swaying. Clothing: flowing silk in bronze and earth-gold with crossed collars embroidered with Dipper stars and wave crests, a short sea-blue silk jacket over an iron-grey over-robe, wide sleeves tied back, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: a large gold hoop earring in the left ear; a brass spyglass in her right hand; a small bag of coin at her belt; slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, its grip covered in pebbled grey ray-skin, an oval guard of salt-dulled steel with a faint salt bloom along the blade, a scabbard of dark tarred leather capped in brass and a loop of tarred cord for a tassel. Power: a little pale-blue water mist curls round her wrist and the sword. Background: a harbour at dusk-blue dawn, three small boats and a pale sea in mist. Light: silver spirit-light off the water from the upper left, a glint on the hoop, a quivering net of reflected light across her face. Expression: a bold, impatient face with a lifted chin and a hard sidelong stare, a thin, hungry smile.

people.imagined: Pre-dawn at the great gate, lantern in hand, he leans against the pillar he has leaned on for forty years, ready to throw the bar so that the city may wake before the sun.
people.subject: The moment: before dawn he stands beside a huge gate pillar with a lantern held in his forearm, in the stoop of long leaning, looking out at the viewer. Face: lean, mild and patient, long and grooved with lines; tired grey eyes; thin grey brows; a long nose; a calm mouth; a clean-shaven jaw; the lantern warms the lined planes of his cheekbones from below. Hair: grey, tied in a plain knot with a bronze pin. Body: tall and stooped, leaning to one side as if his shoulder had worn a hollow in the pillar. Clothing: layered silk in deep bronze and earth-gold with crossed collars and an iron-grey over-robe, long wide sleeves, the borders embroidered with Dipper stars, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the scar must read): on the bare forearm a pale crescent-shaped scar from an old lantern burn, clearly visible as he holds a round paper lantern glowing warm gold; a gate-bar in the other hand; slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, grip wound close in grey hemp cord in a tight diamond pattern, a plain guard of blackened iron, a scabbard of grey oiled wood worn smooth at the lower end, and a small iron gate-key hung from the pommel on a grey cord. Power: a few faint steel-grey motes follow the lantern's glow along the sword. Background: the huge gate shut behind him, iron studs picking up small orange glints, the morning star bright in a deep blue sky of mist. Light: warm lantern gold from below and cold blue pre-dawn moonlight above, a pale rim on his shoulder. Expression: a tired, mild, loyal patience with soft lines at the eyes, the face of a man who has opened this gate for forty years and would not know what else to do.

people.imagined: At the pill furnace, lifting a lid, her cheeks flushed from the heat, her wrists red with cinnabar. She knows what the pouches are for and does not ask more.
people.subject: The moment: at a pill furnace she lifts a heavy lid with a cloth and her face flushes red in the rising heat as she looks coolly at the viewer. Face: round and flushed with high red colour on the cheeks; narrow dark eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a closed, cold mouth; a sheen of sweat and a drop hanging at the jawline; lashes darkened by heat. Hair: black, in a tight knot under a pale grey silk cap pinned with silver. Body: short, strong and sturdy. Clothing: layered silk in bronze and earth-gold with crossed collars, the Dipper-star borders embroidered in gold, an iron-grey over-robe with the sleeves rolled and tied back with silk cords, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and a small silver star at the collar, a clean dark alchemist's silk apron-cloth over the skirts. Hands and objects (the red wrists must read): both wrists and forearms stained deep cinnabar-red, a bright vermilion that looks like paint, clearly visible; a clay furnace with its lid in her hand, rising pink steam; rows of small brown pill jars on a shelf. Power: a soft ember glow breathes out of the furnace mouth with a few drifting sparks of orange light. Background: an alchemy room in rosy haze, copper pots gleaming in rows along the wall. Light: orange-red furnace glow from the lower left with a thin rim of silver on her cheek. Expression: a cool, flushed, incurious calm, narrow eyes steady and the mouth closed, a woman who knows what the pouches are for and has chosen not to ask.

people.imagined: On a road, a satchel on her hip, she stops and drums her fingers on it in a tune she hopes nobody hears. The tune is one of his. She is learning in secret.
people.subject: The moment: on a country road she stands with her fingers drumming on a leather satchel at her hip and a faraway, secretly happy look. Face: gentle, thin and young; large soft brown eyes lifted dreamily; fine curved brows; a small nose; a small shy smile; a faint flush at the cheekbones and long dark lashes. Hair: black, in two loose braids pinned up with small jade pins, windblown. Body: slender, thin-calved, narrow-shouldered, a walker's build. Clothing: soft silk in bronze and earth-gold with crossed collars embroidered with Dipper stars, a short iron-grey over-robe with long sleeves tied back, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and no star, the hem dusty to the knee, a worn leather strap crossing her chest. Hands and objects: the fingertips of the right hand drumming on a brown leather satchel with a brass buckle; a rolled blank letter tucked into her belt; a walking staff in the left hand; a small bamboo flute-case half hidden under her left arm, covered by her sleeve. Power: faint ochre and pale green motes drift off her fingertips in time with the drumming. Background: a road lined with pines in drifting mist under a pale moon. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left with dappled shadow from the pine boughs across the satchel. Expression: a faraway, secretly happy look with soft eyes and a small closed-mouth smile, lips just parting as if humming.

people.imagined: Dozing behind the censers when the hall empties, sandalwood smoke in his clothes. His eyelids droop by noon, and he starts awake when the fire hisses.
people.subject: The moment: behind a large bronze censer he sits slumped with eyes half closed and head nodding, then jerks, startled, his eyes wide on the viewer. Face: young, round, soft and innocent; large sleepy eyes with drooping lids; thin brows; a small flat nose; a slack open mouth; a soot smudge on one cheek and a faint smear of grey ash on the forehead; long soft lashes. Hair: black, cropped and a bit messy, a few strands on end from the nap with a wisp of smoke curling through them. Body: slight and slumped, a servant's thin shoulders, knees drawn up and back against the foot of the censer. Clothing: a clean, plain servant's tunic of undyed grey silk-cotton with a crossed collar and short sleeves, mended neatly at both elbows with matching thread, a simple rope belt, no cord or star, and it smells of sandalwood. Hands and objects: a long iron poker in his lap and a basket of pale scented wood chips beside him; thin white smoke curling round him. Power: a few faint green motes float up with the sandalwood smoke. Background: a hall of huge bronze censers and pillars in golden haze. Light: warm gold spirit-light through the smoke from the upper left with a soft silver rim on his round cheek. Expression: heavy, nodding lids and a slack mouth startling into wide eyes and a flush of embarrassment.

people.imagined: At dawn in the deer meadow, an old man speaks softly to a hind that has put her nose into his hand. He has never spoken so gently to a person.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a meadow at dawn an old man holds out an open palm to a young deer that is nuzzling it, his face soft with tenderness. Face: thin, gentle, old and lined; faded blue eyes; wispy white brows; a long straight nose; a soft smile; a thin white beard with a tuft of deer hair caught in it; tiny brown freckles of age at the temples and eyes damp with feeling. Hair: white and wispy, in a small knot with a pale jade pin. Body: thin and bent, kneeling with long careful hands, a folded cloth padding his knees against the wet grass. Clothing: soft, simple pale-grey silk robes, plain and clean but graceful, softened by washing, with crossed collars hemmed in faint bronze thread and wide sleeves; no cord and no star; the cuffs stained with rusty-brown antler velvet, clearly visible as brown smears. Hands and objects: an open palm with salt held out; a young brown deer with soft pale spots and velvet-covered small antlers; a shepherd's crook beside him. Power: a few faint motes of green and silver light drift between his palm and the hind's nose. Background: a misty meadow, tall grasses and pale birch trunks, mist glowing silver-white. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left with spirit-light on each dewdrop and the hind's breath. Expression: a soft, wet-eyed tenderness, brows lifted and the mouth gently open, the gentleness of a man who has never been this kind to a person.

people.imagined: Alone on the Level Beam at dusk, training twice as long as the others, with a stone weight in each hand and her square chin lifted, sweat shining.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a training ground she stands with a round grey stone weight in each hand at her sides, chin lifted stubbornly, sweat on her brow. Face: a square, broad, sun-red young face; a strong square chin; steady brown eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a firm closed mouth; sunburnt ears that stick out; cheeks blotched red with effort and sweat running down the temple. Hair: brown, in a thick single braid down the back tied with a plain bronze-coloured cord, a few sweat-darkened strands stuck to her brow. Body: stocky, strong and broad-shouldered. Clothing: simple graceful silk in pale bronze, a crossed collar and short wide sleeves, a plain embroidered border of small mountain ridges, no cord or star; both wrists show many tiny pale nicks and scratches from barley awns, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a round grey stone weight in each hand; a long wooden beam on trestles before her. Power: a soft haze of ochre motes rises from the stones and clings to her fists. Background: a dusk training yard in violet mist, a pale rack of weights, a few distant trainees and a low barley field turning gold. Light: warm low dusk light from the upper left, a bright silver-gold rim on her chin and shoulder. Expression: a stubborn, shining, tight-lipped determination, chin raised and brow damp, a girl who will keep training after the others have gone in.

people.imagined: Sitting on the weight-rack with a knucklebone game going, calling out a bet while another boy carries his weights. His toes splay in his sandals.
people.subject: The moment: sprawled on a bench he shakes a handful of knucklebones in a fist and grins, wagering with a friend off to the side. Face: a broad, cheerful, sleepy-eyed young face, sunburnt; half-lidded brown eyes with a gambler's glint; thick brows; a snub nose; a wide, easy grin; dimples in both cheeks; a shadow of first stubble and a tiny scar in the left eyebrow. Hair: black, cropped and uneven, a small bit of straw behind one ear. Body: stocky, lazy, a carter's thick legs, knees apart and one elbow propped on his thigh. Clothing: rumpled pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars and sleeves pushed up, a loosened sash, no cord or star; wide cart-boy's toes spread in open sandals, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a fist full of small white knucklebones with a few scattered on the bench; a bulging pocket that rattles; a bowl of barley dumplings. Power: a few faint ochre motes tumble in the air with the thrown bones. Background: a yard in warm mist with a weight rack and a boy staggering past with stone weights. Light: bright golden afternoon glow from the upper left and a clean rim on his cheek and shoulder, crisp shadows of bench legs across his sandals. Expression: a lazy, sunburnt, gambler's grin with half-closed eyes, the carefree look of a boy who is sure the next throw will be his.

people.imagined: In the kitchen she has a heavy pot held out in each hand like weights, practising, face pink from the stove, and a smear of flour up her arms.
people.subject: The moment: in a kitchen she holds a heavy iron cooking pot in each outstretched hand like practice weights, her round face pink with effort. Face: round, pale and curd-white, flushed pink over the cheeks; kind small brown eyes; soft thin brows; a button nose; a shy smile; a fleck of flour on one eyebrow. Hair: light brown, in a thick plait coiled and tied with a pale silk cloth, a few loose strands stuck to her damp forehead. Body: round, short and sturdy, elbows locked and her whole frame braced against the weight. Clothing: simple pale bronze silk robes with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the elbow, a clean undyed linen apron over the skirts, no cord or star. Hands and objects: flour to the elbows, white and thick, clearly visible; two heavy iron pots held out level, the knuckles white round the handles; a bowl of cream curd on the table behind her. Power: a few warm ochre motes of light drift up from the pots like steam. Background: a kitchen in a soft veil of white steam, hanging pans and a hearth fire glowing. Light: warm firelight from the lower left with spirit-light shining through the steam and a gentle rim on her round cheek. Expression: a shy, round, pink-cheeked smile of patient effort, lips pressed and eyes bright, quietly pleased that she can still hold the pots level.

people.imagined: Standing in the yard with the falcon on his glove, the gauntlet never taken off. The bird's eye follows the pigeons on the roof. He is looking at them with a smile that does not reach his eyes.
people.subject: The moment: in a yard he stands with a leather gauntlet raised bearing a hooded-eyed brown falcon, and looks to the viewer with a faint, arrogant smile. Face (most important: the talon scar): sharp, handsome and sunburnt; three parallel pale scars slashing down from under the LEFT eye across the cheek, clearly visible; keen amber-brown eyes; thin arched brows; a hooked nose; a thin cruel smile. Hair: black, cropped short with a high topknot held by a thin leather cord, a few black strands across his forehead. Body: lean, upright and proud, shoulders square, the gauntleted arm steady as a post. Clothing: graceful pale bronze silk with crossed collars embroidered in small gold mountain ridges and tight sleeves, no cord or star, a thick brown leather gauntlet on the whole left forearm. Hands and objects: the falcon, brown barred with a pale breast, gripping the gauntlet with large yellow talons; a leather jess in his hand. Power: a faint ochre and gold glimmer plays along the falcon's wing feathers. Background: a stone yard in cool mist, several pale pigeons perched on a roof. Light: silver spirit-light from the upper left, the falcon's feathers catching a bright rim as it glares at the viewer. Expression: a faint, arrogant smile that does not reach his cold eyes, chin slightly raised.

people.imagined: Pouring a cup from a wine-skin for a debtor, grinning with a missing canine, thumb over the skin's mouth as he waters it. He is watching how much the debtor trusts him.
people.subject: The moment: he tilts a leather wine-skin to pour pale mare's-milk wine into a small clay cup with a big steppe grin, one eye on the viewer's face. Face (most important: the missing canine): broad, weathered and red-brown; broad cheekbones; narrow black eyes crinkled in a grin; thin brows; a flat wide nose; a huge grin with an upper canine tooth plainly missing, a dark gap in the smile; a thin black moustache. Hair: black, in a long single braid with a bright red silk thong, glossy with mutton fat. Body: stocky, bow-legged, a rider's frame. Clothing: loose pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars and wide sleeves, a steppe-style sash, no cord or star; a leather wine-skin slung over the shoulder and a second belted at the waist like a second belt. Hands and objects: the wine-skin in his right hand pouring into the cup; his left thumb over the water-hole. Power: a few small ochre motes of light float up from the wine in the cup. Background: a dusty wall and a camel's head in warm mist. Light: low golden spirit-light from the upper left, the wine in the cup glowing amber and throwing a pale reflection on his chin. Expression: a big gap-toothed steppe grin with one eye narrowed, watching how far the viewer trusts him.

people.imagined: On the wall at dusk, chapped lips, her eyes looking past the stone to the plain. The eagle-bone charm in her hair clicks in the wind. She wants one place to stay and cannot stop looking out.
people.subject: The moment: on a wall in the wind she gazes far past the viewer toward a horizon, chin lifted, the wind pulling her hair. Face: lean, tanned and wind-chapped; very pale cracked lips; wide dark eyes fixed on a far distance; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth. Hair: long black hair in many thin braids blown sideways, with a small white eagle-bone charm carved like a feather braided into one braid, clearly visible. Body: slim, wiry and tall, boots planted on the parapet's edge, leaning a little into the wind, one hand clenched on a braid. Clothing: pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars and wide sleeves blown back, a short fleece-lined silk vest in soft cream, a woven red-and-brown nomad sash at the waist, no cord or star. Hands and objects: a hand gripping the wall's edge; a short bow slung on her back; past the left shoulder rises the tan-corded hilt of a plain narrow straight sword slung on the back, its ochre-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of plain grey steel. Power: faint ochre motes stream sideways in the wind from her sleeves. Background: a vast yellow steppe and pale sky in haze, in the far distance a line of small dark yurts and a thread of smoke. Light: wind-washed silver-gold low light from the upper left with a pale rim along her cheek. Expression: fickle, brave and reclusive, always half elsewhere, the unfocused look of someone counting the days to the spring move.

people.imagined: Leaning with his ear to a wall, tapping it with a knuckle, listening to its answer, grey mortar dust on his hands. He is learning to fail better.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a stone wall with one ear pressed to it, he taps the stone with a knuckle and listens with eyes closed. Face: calm, round and open; thick-lidded closed eyes with dark lashes on his cheeks; thick brows; a broad nose; a mild small smile; a mortar-grey smudge on one cheek and a fleck of mortar in an eyebrow; a calm line between the brows. Hair: brown, short and curly, with grey dust in it. Body: sturdy, broad, medium height, a mason's hands. Clothing: pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars and sleeves rolled and dusty, small mountain ridges embroidered at the border, no cord or star, a dark leather-trimmed tool belt. Hands and objects: both hands pale mortar-grey to the wrist, clearly visible; a small mason's hammer with a handle dark from gripping and a short plumb line weight hanging from the belt; a wall of squared blocks, each joint straight. Power: faint ochre and ember-orange motes seem to hum out of the stone where his knuckle lands. Background: a wall and scaffold in pale mist, squared grey blocks, the mortar lines like pale threads. Light: soft silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle rim on his ear and shoulder. Expression: a calm, listening stillness with the eyes closed and a mild half-smile, the humble patience of a man learning to fail better.

people.imagined: In a north wind, a sparring stance, flushed cheeks like hot coals, plait ends singed. She has chosen her opponent by the weather and is already grinning.
people.subject: The moment: in a sparring yard in a strong wind she stands in a fighting crouch, fists up, grinning fiercely at the viewer. Face (most important: the fire-red cheeks): a round, strong young face with vivid hot red cheeks as if scorched; bright dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a wide fierce grin; a line of sweat from temple to jaw, scarlet ears and a damp curl on her cheek. Hair: dark brown, in a single plait whose ends are singed, black, frizzled and short. Body: sturdy, compact and planted, shoulders forward. Clothing: graceful pale bronze silk with crossed collars embroidered with small ember-red flame borders, sleeves bound at the wrists, no cord or star. Hands and objects: both fists raised and wrapped in cloth in tight spirals from knuckle to wrist; a wooden training staff leaning at the side; past the right shoulder rises the rust-red-corded hilt of a plain long straight sword slung on the back, its red-brown scabbard on a plain strap, the blade darkened to a warm tint. Power: a faint red heat shimmer round her hands and tiny sparks of orange light at her knuckles. Background: a sparring ground in swirling mist with a flag whipping in the wind. Light: hard silver-white spirit-light from the upper left and an ember-red rim along her cheek and fists. Expression: a fierce, laughing, hot-blooded grin with narrowed bright eyes, a girl who has chosen her opponent by the weather and cannot wait.

people.imagined: Sweeping the barrow steps in autumn with a broom he oils like a blade, rolling gait, calm among the mounds, goat bells jingling in memory.
people.subject: The moment: on a long flight of old stone steps he sweeps with a broom held like a staff, looking up with a calm patient look. Face: lean, weathered, dark and calm; mild brown eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a small closed mouth with a small dry smile; wispy black stubble; large ears; bony shoulders beneath the cloth. Hair: black, in a short knot with a red maple leaf caught in it, a straw hat slung on his back. Body: long-legged and easy, a goatherd's rolling stride. Clothing: simple pale bronze silk robes, sun-faded but laundered clean, crossed collars and short sleeves, no cord or star, goat-hide leggings neatly laced. Hands and objects: a stout besom broom with a very dark, polished handle gleaming with oil, held like a weapon; autumn leaves on the steps. Power: faint ochre motes rise with the dust of each sweep and glint like gold flecks. Background: long stone steps in autumn mist, a green grave mound, red leaves drifting. Light: golden low spirit-light from the upper left, the dust rising in a soft glow, a pale rim on his jaw. Expression: a calm, dry, loyal half-smile with steady eyes, an easy patience among the quiet mounds.

people.imagined: At the rice pot lending grains at two for one, the string of copper cash around her neck clicking, a sly merchant's calm. Her heels are cracked from the road.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a rice pot with a scoop in her hand and a sly, friendly smile, a loop of copper coins swinging at her neck. Face: lively, round and tanned; sharp bright dark eyes; thin arched brows; a small nose; a wide mouth in a bargaining smile; a dusting of freckles across the nose and a small gap between the front teeth. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a red silk cord in a neat bow. Body: short and strong, a walker's calves. Clothing: pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars and short wide sleeves, small gold ridge embroidery on the borders, no cord or star, bare feet in sandals with deeply cracked heels. Hands and objects (the coins must read): a long string of copper coins with square holes looped many times round her neck, clearly visible; a rice scoop in her right hand; a pot of white rice. Power: a few ochre and silver motes glint among the coins as they swing. Background: a dining yard with benches and a smoky kitchen in warm haze, a line of camel silhouettes faintly visible at its edge. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left with a bright rim on the coins and her cheek. Expression: a sly, friendly smile with bright, shrewd eyes and a tilted head.

people.imagined: Dozing on the weight-rack in the sun with his big shaggy dog asleep across his lap, hair all over his coat; he is trusting the dog to guard.
people.subject: The moment: sitting against a rack asleep, head tipped back, with a large shaggy grey dog sprawled across his lap. Face: mild, sleepy and tanned; closed eyes with a line of sun across the lids; thin brows; a flat nose with peeling skin; a loose half-open mouth; cracked lips and a tiny line of drool on his chin. Hair: brown and tousled, a long grey dog hair stuck to his lower lip and shifting with his breath. Body: sturdy, loose and relaxed. Clothing: simple pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars, no cord or star, the sleeves and chest covered in long grey and white dog hairs, clearly visible, clinging in drifts. Hands and objects: a callus on the right palm as one hand rests open on the dog's back; a shepherd's staff beside him; the shaggy grey dog with one open watchful eye, its chin heavy on his knee. Power: a few soft ochre motes drift up from the dog's fur in the light. Background: a weight rack of round grey stones in pale mist, a broad pale sky above and a small gate with a lantern behind. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left with a soft silver rim on his cheek and the dog's ears. Expression: a slack, trusting, blissful doze, the lips loose and the brow smooth, a young man who has handed the guarding to the dog.

people.imagined: Cross-legged on the ground, counting breaths on a cord, tying a knot at each one, the red rope-burn rings round her fingers, while someone has asked to see her knots.
people.subject: The moment: sitting cross-legged she ties a knot in a thin cord between her fingers, counting a breath, eyes lowered, serious. Face: thin, quiet and serious; downcast dark eyes with long lashes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small closed mouth with the lower lip caught in her teeth; a small crease of concentration between the brows; small pale ears and fine down on her cheek. Hair: black, in a tight braid coiled at the back, a thin knotted cord woven through it. Body: slender, upright and small. Clothing: graceful pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars, no cord or star; her cuffs carry a row of braided cords and tiny knots sewn into them, clearly visible. Hands and objects: raised rope-burn rings, pale red bands, round several fingers of both hands, standing out raw against pale skin; a long thin cord with many neat knots in a row, trailing across her lap. Power: a few thin ochre threads of light follow the cord through her fingers. Background: a plain stone floor and wall in soft mist, a stack of coiled rope on a peg and a spindle on the wall. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left with a pale rim on her lowered lashes and fingers. Expression: a quiet, serious, absorbed concentration, eyes lowered and lips pressed, a girl who would rather be left alone with her knots.

people.imagined: At a table in the dining hall, his knee jiggling beneath it, laughing too loudly at his own story of the gorge; the whole room has stopped to look.
people.subject: The moment: at a table he throws back his head in a huge laugh, one fist banging the table, the knee beneath it visibly bouncing. Face: broad, tanned and merry; bright dark eyes squeezed in laughter and wet; thick arched brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth with white teeth; windburn on the cheeks, a nick on the chin from a hasty shave, laugh creases fanning at the eyes and a flushed throat. Hair: black, short and wild, with a wet-looking curl on the brow and a rope-fibre tuft caught in it. Body: broad-shouldered with strong river-hardened arms, restless, one free hand slapping his thigh, shoulders shaking. Clothing: pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars, sleeves rolled up, a blue river-silk scarf at the neck, no cord or star. Hands and objects: a fist on the table; a wooden bowl and a pair of chopsticks scattered; a coil of rope over the shoulder; slung across the back, the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword rises past the right shoulder, in an ochre-brown scabbard, grip wrapped in tan cord, a dull bronze guard. Power: little sparks of ember-orange and warm ochre motes jump around his shaking shoulders. Background: a dining hall in golden haze with long benches and faces turned toward him. Light: warm lantern glow from a high window at the upper left across his face, the roomful of onlookers left in soft shadow, a gold rim on his neck. Expression: a loud, wet-eyed, helpless roar of laughter with the head thrown back, the face of a man who can never be quiet and is delighted by it.

people.imagined: Stitching a winter coat by lamplight, a needle in her fingertips, felt fuzz clinging to her sleeves like frost. She is behind in the primer and does not mind.
people.subject: The moment: sitting with a thick grey felt coat across her lap, she pulls a needle through and looks up warmly at the viewer. Face: soft, round and kind; gentle brown eyes; soft curved brows; a small nose; a small smile; slightly pink eyelids from long evenings of sewing, a thin white thread stuck to her lip, a few pale freckles across her nose. Hair: black, in a bun covered with a soft grey cloth, a pin cushion pinned at the temple, a few white felt-fibres in the loose strands. Body: small, round-shouldered, hunched over the work with her feet tucked under her. Clothing: simple pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars, no cord or star, the sleeves covered all over with white felt fuzz like frost, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the fingertips of both hands dotted with tiny red needle-prick marks; a needle and thick thread; a heap of grey winter coats beside her. Power: a few tiny ochre and silver motes drift up from the felt in the lamplight. Background: a workshop in warm haze with rolls of felt. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, the small bright flame reflected in both her eyes, a soft gold rim on her hair and sleeve. Expression: a soft, humble, patient smile with warm eyes, the kind look of a girl who is behind in her primer and entirely unbothered.

people.imagined: Filing his fingernails to a point with a small file, eyes darting round the yard, hand resting on a stone weight he has filed a hair light.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a weight rack he draws a small steel file along a fingernail while his sharp eyes dart sideways at the viewer and beyond. Face (most important: darting eyes): narrow, sharp and clever; quick dark eyes caught mid-dart, whites showing at one side; thin pointed brows; a thin nose; a thin smirk; a line of sweat on the upper lip, a pulse at the temple and sharp cheekbones over a slightly hollow cheek. Hair: black, slicked, in a neat tight knot, two sharp strands falling forward onto the brow. Body: thin, wiry and always poised. Clothing: tidy pale bronze silk robes with crossed collars and neat sleeves, a narrow gold border of small ridges, no cord or star. Hands and objects: the fingernails filed to sharp points, clearly visible; a small steel nail-file; beside him a rack with a round grey weight slightly smaller than its neighbours. Power: a faint ochre shimmer clings to the weights, and one pale metal mote glints on his file. Background: a yard in cool mist where the long beam stands dim behind him and a pair of disciples carry weights past in soft focus. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a thin rim on his sharp cheekbone and nose. Expression: a thin, quick smirk that stops before it reaches the eyes, which keep sliding sideways, the look of a man who has already weighed the room.

people.imagined: Reading a letter moving his lips, silk cord on a cheap wooden token, promising a boy payment for carrying his weights, and not noticing the promise is not kept.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a small paper held in both hands he mouths the words as he reads, brow furrowed. Face: plump, soft and pleasant; small round brown eyes; thin high brows; a small nose; lips visibly moving; pink cheeks, a faint double chin, a frown of effort between the brows and a thin gloss of oil on the nose. Hair: black and glossy, in a neat topknot tied with a ribbon of real red silk. Body: plump and soft-shouldered, a merchant's son. Clothing: slightly finer pale bronze and gold silk than his fellows, crossed collars with embroidered ridge borders, no cord or star; at his chest a cheap wooden token on a rich red silk cord, the token plain and the cord glossy, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a small blank paper; a small abacus on a thong at his belt; a second boy, out of focus, carrying a heavy stone weight behind him. Power: a pale ember-orange and ochre glimmer sits on the silk cord. Background: a yard in pale mist, the corner of a bench and a ring of boys at the edge. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left showing the sheen of a lightly oiled forehead. Expression: a puzzled, pleased, moist-lipped frown of effort, brow furrowed over the words, a man who is sure he has been generous and never counts the cost.

people.imagined: Surfacing in thought: a long, slow diver's breath held in, her salt-white eyebrow streak lifted, and she laughs, her ears popping.
people.subject: The moment: she draws a long, deep, slow breath, chest lifted, then bursts into soft laughter, a hand rising to an ear. Face (most important: the salt-white eyebrow streak): calm, broad and tanned; a clear streak of salt-white in the LEFT eyebrow like a stripe of chalk; clear grey-green eyes; a small straight nose; a wide laughing mouth; water beads on her lashes and pink cold cheeks. Hair: wet-dark brown, in a single plait over her shoulder, slicked back with seawater and dripping slowly onto her collar, a few strands stuck to her neck. Body: strong, broad-shouldered, a diver's deep chest, tanned freckled shoulders. Clothing: simple pale bronze silk robes, collar damp, crossed collars and short sleeves, a pale sea-blue silk cord at the waist with a small mother-of-pearl shell, no star. Hands and objects: one hand lifted to the ear, the other holding a small white pearl between two fingers. Power: a few pale-blue water motes and bright bubbles rise around her. Background: a wall and a strip of pale sea sky in mist, a line of white gulls and a small boat far out. Light: bright silver sea-light from the upper left, a glow on the damp skin of her collarbone and a luminous rim on her wet hair. Expression: a calm, glad, breathless laugh, eyes bright and the mouth wide, the relief of a girl who has surfaced and is generous with it.

people.imagined: On the war-hall yard, ready, with a broken nose, a heavy ore-hauler's neck bulging, hand on his sword. He has been told the war is coming and he cannot wait.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone yard he stands braced with one hand on a sword hilt and his chin lowered, eyes burning toward the viewer. Face (most important: the broken nose): rugged, square and young; the nose visibly broken across the bridge, a flattened, crooked, thickened lump, clearly the focus; fierce dark eyes; thick straight brows; a thin firm mouth; a fine scar across the chin; a hard-set jaw with the muscles standing at the hinge. Hair: black, in a tight topknot tied with a strip of grey silk, a few hairs stuck to the sweat on his neck. Body: very thick neck, broad powerful shoulders and a hauler's heavy trapezius. Clothing: bold bronze and earth-gold silk with crossed collars embroidered with Dipper stars, tight sleeves under an iron-grey over-robe, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and no star. Hands and objects: the right hand on the hilt of a straight sword in a plain dark sheath; the left clenched. Power: a few steel-grey motes of light gather along the sheath. Background: a yard in cold mist with a rank of spears and a banner of plain grey cloth. Light: hard silver spirit-light from the upper left picking out each ridge of the broken nose and the scar on his chin, a pale rim on his jaw. Expression: a lowered chin with burning, eager eyes and a bulging jaw, the broken nose flared.

people.imagined: In the array chamber, she cocks her head toward a faint hum from one of the seven stones and her gold-flecked freckles catch the light. She has felt one anchor dim.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim chamber she tilts her head sharply to one side, listening with eyes unfocused, as if she heard a faint hum. Face (most important: gold-flecked freckles): a pale, narrow, intent face; across the nose and cheeks, freckles speckled with real tiny flecks of gold that glint, clearly visible; wide grey eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small parted mouth. Hair: copper-brown, in a tight bun with a silver pin, a few copper strands escaping to curl round her ears. Body: slender, upright and attentive. Clothing: fine layered silk in bronze and earth-gold with crossed collars and tight sleeves under a dark iron-grey over-robe, borders embroidered in gold with the seven Dipper stars, a sash with a black cord of seven knots and no star. Hands and objects: one hand raised, fingers spread, as if feeling a hum in the air; behind her, seven small standing stones in a curved row, one of them visibly dimmer than the others. Power: a soft steel-grey and gold glow pulses in the six bright stones and faint motes drift toward her fingers. Background: a dim chamber in mist with faint glowing circle lines on the floor. Light: soft pale spirit-light from the standing stones and cool silver light from the upper left. Expression: calm, diligent and paranoid; listening, her eyes unfocused and her lips slightly parted, as if she were hearing a distant note.
